latest_release.name: Release 3.51.0
latest_release.body: ### 30 new icons: - `outline/adjustments-flame` - `outline/adjustments-key` - `outline/arrow-move-down-x` - `outline/arrow-move-left-x` - `outline/arrow-move-right-x` - `outline/arrow-move-up-x` - `outline/camera-flame` - `outline/camera-key` - `outline/eye-flame` - `outline/eye-key` - `outline/filter-2-flame` - `outline/filter-2-key` - `outline/filter-flame` - `outline/filter-key` - `outline/flag-flame` - `outline/flag-key` - `outline/heart-flame` - `outline/heart-key` - `outline/home-flame` - `outline/home-key` - `outline/mail-flame` - `outline/mail-key` - `outline/photo-flame` - `outline/photo-key` - `outline/settings-flame` - `outline/settings-key` - `outline/sitemap-minus` - `outline/sitemap-plus` - `outline/user-flame` - `outline/user-spark` ### Fixes and improvements - Redraw `shopping-cart-copy`, which was identical to `shopping-cart-check` (#1692) - **Webfont:** Refresh cached webfont icons when their source SVGs change. (#1651) - **Webfont:** Add `U+20` to the `unicode-range` of the `core` chunk so that browsers take the line metrics from Tabler Icons and not from the system fallback font. Since 3.50.0 icons rendered taller than `1em` and sat too high in their line box.
